Name: Simple Shed Expansion (21x20)
Author: StardewNeptune
Description: If you are familiar with XNB mods this will be simple for you. However if you are new and don't understand how these mods work I'll provide you with some simple steps. First download the xnb file attached here. Navigate to your StardewValley folder. Inside should be a folder labelled 'Content' open it and find the folder labelled 'Maps' open that. After opening up the folders until you found "Maps" you should make a backup of the original shed.xnb file or simply rename it to something easy to remember *I personally put an exclamation point in front of the name so it shows up first in the file system and I can see which xnb mods I have installed*. Once you've made a backup of sorts simply drag and drop the Shed.XNB you downloaded here into the Maps Folder and that's it! Run StardewValley and you should have a larger shed for all your needs.
